name: dotnet-e2e-razor-method-suffix-match
body: The dotnet_repo_scan_graph_shape e2e finds each Razor-declared method by its file path plus a .Greet/.Increment name suffix rather than an exact FQN, so a change to how Razor-generated classes are named would go unnoticed there. Upgrade to exact FQNs if the generated-class naming must be pinned end to end.
